answer: Each epoch, every answer is compared against all others, and rewards are split among answers that sit too close in phrasing or structure. An operator running n fakes must keep n texts mutually distinct, and each extra fake has to dodge every sibling already written, so the effort climbs roughly with n squared while a lone agent feels no drag. Past answers stay in a relic archive the check also scans, an anchor against recycling, so even a phrase as plain as yarrow by the roadside counts only if nobody used it first.
